goal: Prevent node crashes on storage write failures when disk space runs out
Allow the node to report storage errors and shut down cleanly instead of terminating abruptly
reviewability: The patch is small, self-contained, clean, and CI is passing
agreement: Concept support after hitting the same bug and testing an alternative fix (w0xlt)
Clarified why graceful shutdown and error reporting is preferable to an immediate abort (andrewtoth)
Suggested finding a wholesale pattern or tooling check rather than piecemeal fixes (maflcko)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes an exception-safety bug where a failed flush left pending bytes
Avoids retrying failed writes and throwing uncatchable exceptions during stack unwinding

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it prevents unhandled process aborts during block and undo data writes when the disk is full
Allows node operators to receive an explicit storage failure error message and a clean exit
